invariants: Analytics defaults to unknown or denied; no analytics SDK loads before explicit current-version consent.
Events that occur before consent are discarded and are never replayed after consent.
A legacy analytics grant does not silently expand to newly added analytics providers.
A legacy or current decline remains declined until the user explicitly changes it.
Revoking consent disables future GA4 and PostHog capture immediately on the current browser.
PostHog autocapture, pageleave capture and session replay remain disabled.
Analytics payloads must not include card data, payment credentials or shipping-form contents.
The user can revisit privacy-choices.html and change the analytics preference.
Legal privacy text remains separately owner-approved and is not generated by the analytics layer.
